direction: User clarification supersedes the original no-person brief: person performing the movement is the subject.

candidates.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural / premium sports movement portrait. Create a square high-resolution canonical movement-identity asset for Strength Ledger: an ADULT ATHLETE ACTUALLY PERFORMING A DUMBBELL INCLINE BENCH PRESS. The performing person is the main subject, not an empty equipment still life. Premium realistic studio photography with a sculptural high-end sports-campaign finish, grounded in actual exercise mechanics. An athletic adult with natural muscular proportions, medium warm skin tone, short hair, wearing unbranded graphite sleeveless training top, matte black shorts and neutral dark training shoes. No shirtless bodybuilding pose. Athlete lies face-up with head, upper back and glutes supported on a mechanically credible adjustable incline bench at 30–35 degrees above horizontal, separate short slightly tilted seat pad, knees bent and both shoes firmly planted on floor. The athlete looks upward along the press path. Exactly TWO matching fixed-weight brushed-metal dumbbells, each correctly gripped in a separate hand with a straight neutral wrist, no extra weights on floor. Bilateral incline CHEST press: upper arms about 45–60 degrees from torso, forearms under handles, natural modest thoracic arch, not a shoulder press, curl or fly. Both dumbbells and both forearms must remain separately readable and visible. Realistic hands/fingers, plausible shoulders/elbows/wrists, no limb merging. Bench frame, hinge and single adjustment brace mechanically coherent. Dark near-black OLED studio and near-black floor, tiny contact shadows, no clutter or mirror. Soft neutral key from upper left/front illuminates skin, hands and clean steel highlights; subtle violet edge light from back right and extremely restrained magenta bounce. Neutral graphite equipment, NOT purple-painted equipment. Natural skin remains skin, NOT a glowing anatomy mannequin. Crisp silhouette and clear weight-to-hand relationships readable at 48–72px. Moderate three-quarter SIDE-FRONT view with normal 60–70mm lens character, camera around seated chest height, no wide-angle distortion. Entire athlete, both dumbbells and bench feet stay inside the central 84% of the SQUARE image, no clipped head, shoes, hands, weights or bench. Use the space well; no excessive empty upper half. No text, logos, branding, watermarks, anatomy diagrams or muscle overlays. One single photo, no UI or contact sheet. Capture the MID-PRESS moment: the two dumbbells are rising above the upper chest, elbows still softly bent around 100–115 degrees so the exercise action is immediately visible. The bench head is toward upper-left and the planted feet toward lower-right. Camera sees the chest-facing side and a clear side profile of the inclined back pad; near and far arms stay visibly separated. Athlete is exerting controlled effort, calm concentrated expression. The dumbbells are held at equal height relative to shoulders, gently perspective-correct.
